bdsg.muc_dich: Huan luyen tren MOT GPU 24GB (3090 / 4090 / A5000). Ban chinh de danh gia.

tham_so_uoc_tinh.bo_nho_huan_luyen_tinh_ra_sao: AdamW giu ban fp32 cua trong so (4 byte) + hai moment (4+4 byte) + gradient (4 byte) = 16 byte moi tham so. 136867584 * 16 / 1024^3 = 2.04 GiB. CHUA tinh activation, activation phu thuoc batch_size va max_seq_len nen chua do duoc o day.

vi_sao_chon_so_nay: 16 lop thay vi 8: MobileLLM (duoc MiniMind dan lai trong README muc 'Model Configuration') ket luan o quy mo nho, CHIEU SAU an hon CHIEU RONG voi cung ngan sach tham so. minimind2 (104M) cung dung 16 lop o hidden 768.
num_key_value_heads=4 tren 8 query head: GQA ti le 2:1, giam KV cache con mot nua so voi MHA. Day la lua chon cua minimind-3 (khong phai cua minimind2, ban do dung kv=2).
vocab_size=24576: giong het cac cau hinh khac trong ho.
canh_bao: Con so 2.2 GB chi la bo nho trang thai toi uu. Khong duoc dung no de hua 'chay vua 24GB' — chua do activation.
Xem canh bao vocab_size o nho.json, ap dung y het.
